description: Fetch one thing in full by reference: a doc slug ("help/columns/column-definitions"), a demo id ("11-stock-market"), or "api" for the curated API reference. Use svgrid_search first to find the reference.

detail.description: "full" (default) returns the whole thing; "concise" truncates long content.

ref.description: A doc slug, a demo id, "api", or a schema id such as "chart-spec" (or "chart spec schema"). The kind is inferred; pass `kind` to force it.

name: svgrid_get
title: Read a doc or demo
